stemMd: A subscription has 1,200 customers. Eight percent cancel and 150 new customers join. What is the new count?
explanationMd: Cancellations number 96. Thus 1200-96+150=1254. Apply the cancellation rate to the stated original customer base.

distractorRationale.c: Uses the complement of the cancellation count incorrectly.
